prompt:
Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative timeline of the world in an alternate history scenario in which the average life expectancy for humans is 175 yrs.
 Use every standard punctuation mark at least once, including semicolons, colons, and the interrobang (?!).
judge_reasoning: Candidate 3 best follows the punctuation requirements: it includes both semicolons and colons, and it uses the interrobang exactly as (?!), while maintaining a coherent world timeline consistent with an average lifespan of 175. Candidate 4 also includes semicolons, colons, and (?!), and provides a solid alternate-history timeline, but it feels a bit less “designed” around the punctuation constraint than Candidate 3 and ends with a speculative disclaimer. Candidate 1 has semicolons and colons but omits the required interrobang (?!), which is a major explicit constraint miss. Candidate 2 uses a different symbol (‽) rather than the required (?!), and it largely fails the semicolon/interrobang checks, so its punctuation compliance is much weaker overall.
